subject: ISSUE 00137 · 8 STORIES · 11 MIN READ
intro: A local preview of every story and quick-hit variant the daily email can render, from multi-source clusters to a section that only appears when a day has enough human-side items.

stories.headline: Amazon's cloud unit posts record growth while the rest of the quarter misses
stories.summary: AWS growth stayed ahead of the company total, and the spending plan for next year is larger than the one investors had already priced in. Shares moved after the close.
stories.why: The gap between today's capital plan and the revenue promised years out is the part operators will be asked about first.

conflicts: One outlet quotes a 6 percent after-hours drop. The other describes investor nerves and does not give a price move.

stories.headline: A lab's new eval harness shows up in three writeups on the same morning
stories.summary: The paper is an update to a scorecard published last quarter. Two follow-ups disagree on whether the gain is on the same task mix.
stories.why: If the task mix changed, last quarter's number is not a baseline you can cite.

conflicts: The Verge treats the release as a new benchmark. Ars Technica calls it a rerun of the March suite.

stories.headline: A regulator files a short update on an investigation it opened in the spring
stories.summary: The notice adds a hearing date and does not change the claims. No second outlet has matched it.
stories.why: The date is the only new fact. The substance of the case is unchanged.

stories.headline: Four outlets describe the same model release and none of them disagree
stories.summary: The notes line up on context length, price, and the day it reaches the API. There is no second source link beyond the count.
stories.why: When the writeups match, the useful question is who ships access first, not which quote to trust.

stories.headline: A chip supplier's factory tour is covered by one reporter
stories.summary: The piece is a single-source visit. Nothing else in today's set is the same event.
stories.why: Treat the capacity numbers as one newsroom's notes until someone else confirms them.

stories.headline: A one-source tool launch that the cluster step still attached
stories.summary: The cluster badge is below two and it is not an update, so the email should not print a covered-by line.
stories.why: This row exists so a silent cluster stays silent.

stories.headline: A story that arrived without a summary or a takeaway
Maintainers publish a long note on how a widely used library will version its next break
stories.summary: The post lists the symbols that move, the release it lands in, and a one-year window before the old names go away.
stories.why: Teams that pin this library need the window, not the announcement, on the calendar.

tweetHeadlines.headline: Claude's __scheduled tasks__ are the feature most people still run by hand.
A thread argues agent harnesses are eight parts, not a single prompt.
Someone posts a checklist for running a newsletter alone and does not include a link.
Three posts describe the __same eval harness__ before noon.
tweetHeadlines.summary: The thread compares the harness with two earlier internal scorecards.

communityHeadlines.headline: A forum thread collects __launch-day bugs__ from people who tried the new API this morning.
communityHeadlines.summary: Most reports are timeouts on the first request, not wrong answers.

communityHeadlines.headline: A clinic paused its __AI scribe pilot__ after nurses flagged note drift.
communityHeadlines.meaning: Keep a human review step when a tool writes the record of care.

communityHeadlines.headline: Two communities are tracking the __same outage__ with different start times.

items.headline: An open-source runtime __cut cold starts__ on the same hardware.
A maintainer posts the migration notes for next month's break.
A hospital pauses an __AI scribe__ after staff catch notes that were never said.
items.meaning: The review step has to sit with the people whose names are on the note.

items.headline: A newsroom tells reporters which beats the model is not allowed to draft.
